name: visuals
description: Dual-host page building for Claude Code and Codex: when the user asks to see something, a picture is clearly faster than text, or work has a result that can be seen, agents add one self-contained HTML page to a reply that still stands on its own — an explanation page with one main picture and the options side by side, or a demo page of real renders, screenshots and recordings with what was not verified — checked by a shipped zero-dependency page validator. Ordinary answers stay text.
